# Fab

Reference: Minimal UI kit "Buttons" page, section "Fab button" (content only). Created with `/component`.
Reference URL: https://minimals.cc/components/mui/buttons

## Purpose
A floating action button: the primary action of a screen, round (icon) or extended (icon + label).

## Anatomy
```
button[type="button"][data-ok-fab][data-ok-variant][data-ok-color][data-ok-size]
    [data-ok-extended]? [data-ok-animate]? [aria-label (round)]
  svg[aria-hidden="true"]
  text (extended only)
```

## Options
<!-- options:fab (generated by `pnpm specs:options` from the schema in packages/core/src/anatomy/anatomy.ts) -->
Root: `data-ok-fab`. Unknown values fall back to the default.

| React | HTML | Kind | Values | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `variant` | `data-ok-variant="…"` | style | `contained` `outlined` `soft` | `contained` | Visual style. |
| `color` | `data-ok-color="…"` | style | `default` `inherit` `primary` `secondary` `info` `success` `warning` `error` `black` `white` | `default` | `default` (grey), `inherit` (dark), palette. |
| `size` | `data-ok-size="…"` | style | `sm` `md` `lg` | `md` | Round 40 / 48 / 56px; extended 36 / 40 / 48px. |
| `extended` | `data-ok-extended` | flag | boolean | off | Pill with an icon and a label. |
| `animate` | `data-ok-animate` | flag | boolean | off | Scale up on hover, down while pressed. |
| `disabled` | `disabled` | native | boolean | off | Native `disabled`. |
<!-- /options:fab -->

| Variant | Rest | Hover (`hover: hover`) |
|---|---|---|
| contained | bg `main` (default: grey-300, inherit: `--ok-inherit-main`), text `contrast`, shadow `--ok-c-shadow` (z8 for default / inherit / black / white) | bg `hover`, no shadow |
| outlined | border `channel` 48 % (default / inherit 32 %), text `main` (default: secondary text) | bg 8 % |
| soft | bg `channel` 16 %, text `text` | bg 32 % |
| disabled | `--ok-action-disabled` text, `--ok-action-disabled-bg` fill or border, no shadow | — |

## Behavior
Native `<button>`, or `<a href>` for a link — CSS only, no runtime. Positioning (fixed / absolute) is up to the page.

## Keyboard
Native: `Enter` / `Space` activate.

## Accessibility
Round fabs need `aria-label`; extended fabs are named by their label. Icons are `aria-hidden`.
Colors follow the reference (ADR-0014); fabs are exempt from axe `color-contrast` except soft.

## Events / API
None: CSS only, no runtime. React forwards `ref` (`HTMLButtonElement`, or `HTMLAnchorElement` with
`href`) and every native button / link prop.

## Responsive
Same size at every breakpoint; labels don't wrap.

## Upstream API mapping
Upstream: MUI `Fab` (+ `ButtonBase`), mui.com/material-ui/api/fab/.

| Upstream | Owlky | Status | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `variant` (`circular` · `extended`) | `extended` flag | renamed | Owlky's `variant` is the fill style (`contained` · `outlined` · `soft`, reference) |
| `color` (default `default`) | `color` | kept | + `inherit`, `black` / `white` |
| `size` (`small` · `medium` · `large`, default `large`) | `size` (`sm` · `md` · `lg`, default `md`) | renamed | |
| `children`, `disabled`, `href` | same | kept | |
| `component`, `LinkComponent` (ButtonBase) | same | kept | 4.18.22: as on Button (router links; a disabled router link keeps its `href`, `aria-disabled`, `tabindex=-1`, no pointer events) |
| `action`, `focusVisibleClassName`, `onFocusVisible`, `nativeButton` (ButtonBase) | `ref.focus()`, `:focus-visible` | not applicable | |
| `disableRipple`, `disableFocusRipple` (+ ButtonBase ripple props) | — | not applicable | no ripple |
| `sx`, `classes` | — | not applicable | ADR-0015 |

Beyond MUI: `animate` (reference).

## Parity notes
Visible focus outline; CSS-only animate (see Icon button).
